blocks.rationale: Create a focused terminal skill for §3306(c)(2). It corrects the failed domestic-service case by encoding that the exclusion applies only when covered domestic service is below the $1,000 threshold; remuneration at or above the threshold makes the affirmative applicability claim contradictory.

inputs.name: service_is_domestic
inputs.question: Is the service described in the current facts domestic service?

inputs.name: service_in_private_home
inputs.question: Was the service described in the current facts performed in a private home?

inputs.name: service_in_local_college_club
inputs.question: Was the service described in the current facts performed in a local college club?

inputs.name: service_in_local_fraternity_or_sorority_chapter
inputs.question: Was the service described in the current facts performed in a local chapter of a college fraternity or sorority?

inputs.name: cash_remuneration_current_or_preceding_year
inputs.question: How much cash remuneration did the employing person pay for the described domestic service during the calendar year at issue or the preceding calendar year?

inputs.name: question_asserts_section_applies
inputs.question: Does the current question affirm, rather than deny, that section 3306(c)(2) applies to the described service?

skill.intent: Determine whether a claim that 26 U.S.C. §3306(c)(2) applies to a domestic-service relationship is entailed or contradicted.

outputs.description: The current answer label: Entailment if the question's asserted applicability matches §3306(c)(2), otherwise Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

premises.name: domestic_service_cash_threshold

origin.quote: domestic service in a private home, local college club, or local chapter of a college fraternity or sorority unless performed for a person who paid cash remuneration of $1,000 or more to individuals employed in such domestic service in the calendar year or the preceding calendar year

premises.question: What cash-remuneration threshold governs the domestic-service exception in §3306(c)(2)?

origin.quote: domestic service in a private home, local college club, or local chapter of a college fraternity or sorority unless performed for a person who paid cash remuneration of $1,000 or more to individuals employed in such domestic service in the calendar year or the preceding calendar year

source_obligations.statement: Check whether the service is domestic service in one of the enumerated settings and whether the employing person paid less than $1,000 in cash remuneration during the current or preceding calendar year; §3306(c)(2)'s exclusion applies only when those conditions hold.
